title: Partner Operations Desk Note: Wayfare Partner Detailer Work Orders on Cleaning and Damage Fees Reports
content:
A Wayfare partner detailer's work order on a Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning fee report reaches the assessment's evidence ledger as a professional cleaning document without a price, and support records its price as the cleaning cost on file from the partner rate card; a report with no partner work order on its evidence ledger has no partner price, and its cleaning cost on file is recorded as zero.

On the evidence ledger, a partner work order shows as a cleaning receipt submission. The cleaning cost on file is the receipt amount the assessment holds. Recording the price charges nothing to the rider and pays nothing to anyone.

## Pricing a work order on file

A partner work order on file is not priced until the fee level held on the assessment lists the incident category reported in its entry gate.

In the same terms: while the entry gate of the fee level held on the assessment does not list the incident category reported, a partner work order on the evidence ledger stays unpriced, and it is priced once the level held lists that category in its entry gate.

## Tool card: `price_partner_work_order_4e0ef0e3`

**Capability.** Records the price of a Wayfare partner detailer's work order that is already on file for a cleaning report, bringing the report's evidence totals up to date: the cleaning cost on file for the report is set to the amount given. Nothing is charged or paid by this action. Afterwards the assessment lookup shows the new cleaning cost on file.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `price_partner_work_order_4e0ef0e3` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `damage_assessment_id` | the reference number of the cleaning fee assessment whose partner work order is being priced, as returned by the assessment lookup | identifier |
| `cleaning_cost_on_file` | the cleaning cost to hold on file for the report | US dollars as a decimal number rounded half up to 2 decimal places, for example 214.50 |

**Return.** A receipt with: `status` ("cost_recorded" once the amount is on file), `damage_assessment_id` (the assessment reference number) and `cleaning_cost_on_file` (the cost now on file, US dollars with 2 decimal places).

The tool sets the amount it is given; a later call sets the cleaning cost on file to the new amount.
